_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ni mchezaji {player_id} katika mchezo wa LinesOfAction.
Vipande vyako ni '{side}', vipande vya mpinzani ni '{other}'.
Fomu ya kusonga: `[b1b3]` (viwianishi vya chanzo hadi viwianishi vya mwisho). Kusonga kwa njia ya moja, wima, au diagonally idadi ya miraba sawa na jumla ya vipande (rangi yoyote) kwenye mstari huo. Unaweza kuruka juu ya vipande vyako, lakini si vipande vya mpinzani; kutua kwenye mpinzani humkamata.  Ushinde wakati vipande vyote vimeunganishwa kwa njia ya 8-jirani.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Enkola erina kuba e2e4 (okuva,okutuuka ku buwayiro).
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Okutambula kulina okuba nga kutudde oba mu mpenda.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Alina okutambula ewala nga bwe gwenkanankana n'ebitundu ebiragiddwa.

outcome.draw_repetition: Ekifo ky'obadde okirina kiddamu emirundi esatu.
